In my dream i was with my elder brother, we were standing on the terrace of our old house in night it was almost 3.30 in night. we were discussing about deen. i told my brother see the moon Hozoor sallalahu aliahi wa sallam just showed his finger and the moon split in 2 pieces see how Allah can do and while i was telling this i showed my finger to the moon and it split into 2 pieces. Again we were talking then i saw the moon it was a full moon.then again i started to say about moon spliting into 2 i was really excited about this so i was telling him again see how much power allah has Hozoor sallalahu aliahi wa sallam just showed his finger and the moon split in 2 pieces see how Allah can do and while i was telling this i showed my finger to the moon and it split into 2 pieces again i told my brother lets see were this part of moon to my right side goes i saw it for a while than i was not able to see it becasue it had gone far and was looking very tiny then i was speaking with my brother from the right side a storm(twister) came wind was circling very fast and i realised it was coming towards us i told my brother it i coming here we did not run we stood there the wind came to us and me and my brother were in it i caught the pillar so that i dont get blown away and my brother was behind me then the wind took me and i heard some voice i could not here it i felt like some one is operating my heart i could feel pain in my chest the voice asked me something but i dont remember it and then i saw the moon it was full i was still trapped in the storm again a voice asked me are you ready i told yes and the storm stoped and turned into water vapours and all water fell on me and i was breathing heavily i was not able to brethe at all so i went to my house it was morning now and i entered my room and my sleep broke i got up and saw the time it was 3.40 in night still. after i got up i could feel some pain in my chest and heavy brething, i was not able to brethe when i got up i was pulling the air. please tell me about this dream and let me know what i should do i really get strange dreams. Answer ID: 12618 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1151/889=H/1430) It is good dream. It means that you and your relatives will be given taufiq to follow the Shariah and adopt the sunnah and avoid the matters going against sunnah, in-sha-Allah. The dream is an obvious indication that one can not protect himself from the visible and invisible evils unless one follows the sunnah and shuns the sins completely.
